Adapt a proxymix mixture fit

Source: R/emitters.R
manifest_from_gmm.Rd

Lifts a fitted Gaussian-mixture proxy into the contract. In orchestra terms such a fit is an approximation to a posterior over parameters, so it emits a manifest with inferential_target = "parameters", the mixture as the payload, and the manifold it approximated recorded as lineage.

Usage

manifest_from_gmm(
  x,
  ...,
  seed = NA_integer_,
  consumed = list(),
  run_id = NULL,
  emitter_version = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A proxymix::gmm_fit.

...

Unused, present for method compatibility.

seed

The integer RNG seed behind the fit, or NA_integer_.

consumed

A list of upstream manifests this fit approximated. A non-empty list marks the emitted manifest as derived.

run_id

A run identifier. Defaults to "proxymix-" followed by the first twelve hexadecimal digits of a digest of the payload, which makes it stable under re-emission of the same fit.

emitter_version

The emitting component's version. Defaults to the installed proxymix version.

Value

An orchestra_manifest with emitter_package set to "proxymix".

Details

Passing consumed is what marks the result derived, and the class validator then requires the lineage to be non-empty. That is the rule that stops an approximation from quietly losing the provenance of the thing it approximated – a proxy of a calibration ensemble must be traceable back to that ensemble, or a reader has no way to tell an approximation from a fit.

See also

as_orchestra_manifest() for the generic this mirrors, manifest_lineage() for the handle recorded in consumed_manifests.

Author

Max Moldovan

Examples

set.seed(1)
draws <- matrix(stats::rnorm(200), 100, 2, dimnames = list(NULL,
                                                           c("a", "b")))
fit <- proxymix::fit_proxymix(proxymix::gmm_target_from_samples(draws),
                              N = 2L, regime = "sample", max_iter = 50L)
m <- manifest_from_gmm(fit, seed = 1L)
verify_manifest(m)$ok
#> [1] TRUE
